summary.short: Amends Peru's Penal Code and Law 30096 on computer crimes so that use of artificial intelligence, including deepfakes, aggravates or defines offences such as child pornography, defamation, aggravated fraud and copyright crimes. Binding criminal law; implementing regulations due within 60 days of entry into force.
summary.long: Law No. 32314 amends Peru's Penal Code (Decreto Legislativo 635) and Law 30096 on computer crimes to cover the use of artificial intelligence in offences. Article 1 adds AI or similar technologies as an aggravating circumstance (art. 46); extends child pornography (art. 129-M) to AI-based tools and deepfakes; adds a defamation penalty band for content spread through AI or deepfakes (art. 132); creates aggravated fraud for AI manipulation of a third party's voice, image, audio or body movement causing economic loss (art. 196-A(7)); limits copyright offences (arts. 217-219) to works of human authorship; and adds an aggravating case for profit from exploiting a plagiarised work (art. 220(f)). Article 2 adds a fifth aggravating circumstance to art. 11 of Law 30096, letting judges raise penalties by up to one third above the legal maximum for computer crimes committed with AI. The single final provision requires the Executive to issue implementing regulations within sixty calendar days of entry into force. The law imposes no AI-specific licensing, registration or transparency duties; its effects are criminal penalties imposed by courts, in prison terms and day-fines.

notes: Amends the Código Penal and Ley 30096 by inserting AI-use aggravating circumstances and AI-related conduct into several offences; target instruments are not in the registry, so target_instrument_id is empty. Art. 129-M and 132 spell the fine range differently in one place ("trescientos sesenticinco días-multa" vs "trescientos sesenta y cinco"); treated as orthographic variants. The Final Provision sets a 60-calendar-day period from entry into force for the additional regulations; this is a procedural deadline not coded here. Text is the adopted law as published (Lima, 22 April 2025; promulgated 28 April 2025).

thresholds.note: No numeric cutoff changing scope, eligibility, exemption, obligation tier or prohibition was found. Penalty ranges (e.g., Arts. 129-M, 132, 196-A, 218, 220-A to 220-C as amended) are enforcement, not thresholds. The one-third increase above the legal maximum in Art. 2 (inserting numeral 5 into Art. 11 of Ley 30096) is a penalty increase, also enforcement. The sixty-day period in the Disposición Complementaria Final Única is a procedural deadline, recorded as an event, not a threshold.

definitions.note: The text uses 'inteligencia artificial', 'tecnologías similares o análogas' and 'falsificaciones profundas (‘deepfakes’)' as scope-relevant terms without defining them. The parenthetical 'deepfakes' is a translation gloss, not a definition. No definitional provision was found.
